account.title: Account
account.intro: You don't need an account to use minim. It will back up your workflows and bring them to your other computers.
account.unavailable: Accounts are not available in this version of minim yet. The app works normally without an account.
account.offline: Offline: you stay signed in as {{email}}. The connection will resume automatically.
account.modes: Sign in or create an account
account.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
account.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
account.resetIntro: Enter your account's address: you will receive a link to choose a new password.
account.resetSent: If an account exists with this address, an email has just been sent.
account.confirmationSent: Account created. Open the link sent to {{email}} to confirm your address, then sign in.
